description:
As a FinOps analyst, I need to regularly archive and review cloud billing reports located in the /home/user/billing_reports directory. Please compress all the CSV files (ending with .csv) inside /home/user/billing_reports into a single zip archive named cloud_costs_archive.zip and place the archive in your home directory (/home/user). Then, extract the contents of this zip archive into a new directory at /home/user/extracted_reports.

To confirm your actions, create a log file at /home/user/finops_archive_log.txt. The log file must use the following format for verification:

Compressed files:
- <file1.csv>
- <file2.csv>
[...]

Extraction output directory:
- /home/user/extracted_reports

Each bullet under "Compressed files" must exactly list the CSV files that were present in /home/user/billing_reports at compression time, in sorted order. The log file should be written after extraction, reflecting the final action.
